subject: MAP kickoff: eval sprint onboarding, stakeholder rollcall & calendar hold
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference.com>
To: Emily Tan <emily.tan@novacorp.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@novacorp.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff: eval sprint onboarding, stakeholder rollcall & calendar hold

Hi Emily / Raj —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation, I’m sending a short calendar hold for an initial MAP (mutual action plan) kickoff so we can align stakeholders, agree the evaluation plan, and confirm a close timeline. Goal for the call: agree success criteria for the eval sprint and owners for the top-line tasks (data access, test prompts, evaluation rubric, SLA expectations).

Draft agenda attached (MAP_Draft_v1.pdf) plus an evaluation worksheet (EvalPlan_Novacorp_v1.xlsx). Please have the tech lead and program manager join if possible — I’ve cc’d Raj to make sure ops have visibility.

Proposed 60-min slot: Tue, Jun 1, 10:00–11:00 PT (I’ll send a calendar invite with Zoom). If that doesn’t work, alternative windows later this week are Wed 9–10 PT or Thu 11–12 PT.

Quick asks before the call:
- Confirm who will be the day-to-day evaluation owner and their email
- Share any existing evaluation prompts or acceptance criteria you already track
- If you have an onboarding VPN/whitelist requirement, please flag ops contacts (we may need a short firewall whitelist window)

Attaching the drafts so we can iterate live.

Thanks,

Sergio Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0191

Attachments: MAP_Draft_v1.pdf (agenda + roles), EvalPlan_Novacorp_v1.xlsx (evaluation matrix)

From: Emily Tan <emily.tan@novacorp.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@novacorp.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2026 09:45:12 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: eval sprint onboarding, stakeholder rollcall & calendar hold

Sergio —

Thanks for the note and the docs. Jun 1 10:00–11:00 PT works for us. I’ll be on the call; Raj will invite our platform engineer (Alyssa) and our product manager (Maya).

A couple quick context items:
- We’ll want to validate inference latency on a 256-token median and a 1k-token tail; I’ve included those numbers in the EvalPlan sheet.
- We have a standard security whitelist process; ops (cc’d) will coordinate a temporary CIDR allowlist for the eval window.

Emily
Emily Tan
Head of Product Integrations
NovaCorp
emily.tan@novacorp.com

Adding a quick internal note — I’ll run the kickoff and own the MAP timeline on our side. I’ll add a proposed canary schedule to the agenda so we can pick two short eval windows (low-traffic + peak-traffic) to validate both latency and cost.

Sergio — once you push the calendar invite, I’ll add the Zoom link and check our recording/GTM ops. Marcus, can you pull the typical quantization profile notes for reference?
